info.title: FAR / DFARS & CMMC Clause Risk Scanner API
info.description: High-performance, stateless Defense & Federal GovCon regulatory compliance microservice. Scans Section I / Section K federal solicitation and contract text to extract FAR, DFARS, and agency supplement clauses, flags mandatory subcontractor flow-downs, identifies high-burden compliance triggers (Cost Accounting Standards, Buy American/BAA, Unlimited Technical Data Rights), and computes an actionable CMMC 2.0 / NIST SP 800-171 / DFARS 7012/7019/7020/7021 cyber readiness profile.

post.summary: Scan Federal & Defense Contracts for FAR/DFARS Risks, Flow-Downs & CMMC 2.0 Mandates
post.description: Accepts raw text from a federal/DoD solicitation (Section C, H, I, K, or L) or subcontract agreement and returns a strictly validated JSON regulatory audit containing every detected FAR/DFARS/agency clause, severity rating, mandatory subcontractor flow-down flag, compliance burden assessment, remediation guidance, and a dedicated CMMC 2.0 / NIST SP 800-171 / FedRAMP cyber compliance profile.

200.description: Successfully audited FAR/DFARS clauses and generated CMMC 2.0 compliance profile.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity - Payload validation failure or LLM schema extraction failure.

502.description: Bad Gateway - Upstream LLM inference provider error.

get.description: Unprotected health check endpoint for marketplace SLA monitoring.

ContractorRole.description: Role of the contractor auditing the solicitation or contract.

ClauseRiskSeverity.description: Severity level of the regulatory, financial, IP, or cyber risk introduced by the clause.

ComplianceBurdenLevel.description: Operational and administrative compliance burden level.

CMMCLevelRequired.description: CMMC 2.0 certification level required or implied by the solicitation clauses.

raw_text.description: Unstructured text from a federal/DoD solicitation (Section C, H, I, K, or L) or subcontract agreement containing FAR/DFARS/agency clauses.
raw_text.example: SECTION I - CONTRACT CLAUSES: This solicitation incorporates by reference: FAR 52.215-2 (Audit and Records - Negotiation), FAR 52.230-2 (Cost Accounting Standards), DFARS 252.204-7012 (Safeguarding Covered Defense Information and Cyber Incident Reporting), DFARS 252.204-7020 (NIST SP 800-171 DoD Assessment Requirements), DFARS 252.204-7021 (Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Requirements - CMMC Level 2 Required), and DFARS 252.227-7013 (Rights in Technical Data - Noncommercial Items; Government demands Unlimited Rights in all deliverables developed under this contract).

clause_title.example: Safeguarding Covered Defense Information and Cyber Incident Reporting

flowdown_applicability_notes.example: Must flow down verbatim to all subcontractors handling Covered Defense Information (CDI) or operationally critical support.

plain_english_obligation.example: Requires full implementation of NIST SP 800-171 security controls on covered contractor information systems and mandatory 72-hour DoD cyber incident reporting via DIBNet.

financial_or_ip_exposure.example: False Claims Act (FCA) treble damages exposure if SPRS self-assessment score or System Security Plan (SSP) is misrepresented; breach termination risk.

remediation_or_negotiation_action.example: Verify active Medium/High SPRS score, update SSP and POA&M prior to proposal submission, and isolate CUI enclave.

fedramp_Requirement.example: FedRAMP Moderate baseline equivalencies required for external Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) storing CDI.

cyber_summary.example: Offeror must maintain an active NIST SP 800-171 assessment in SPRS (DFARS 252.204-7019/7020), achieve CMMC Level 2 certification prior to award (DFARS 252.204-7021), and enforce 72-hour DoD cyber incident reporting.
